title: Proper geometric-point derived direct image preserves copowers
statement: Let Λ be a finite commutative ring, k an algebraically closed field, and p : X → Spec k proper. For every indexing type I and every object E in the ordinary unbounded derived category of small-etale Λ-module sheaves on X, the right derived direct image Rp_* preserves the coproduct cocone of the constant I-family at E.

source.place: Lemma 59.96.3 and its coproduct comparison argument

proof.text: The additive group of the finite coefficient ring is torsion by isAddTorsion_of_finite, including the zero ring. Properness supplies local finite type, quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness. Treat p as a morphism of finite-type schemes over k, using the identity structure map on Spec k. The source finite-dimension theorem applies since an algebraically closed field is separably closed.

Apply the proved source coproduct theorem to p with the resulting cohomological-dimension witness. It preserves every I-indexed coproduct; specialize the instance to the constant family at E. All cocones and comparisons are the canonical ones. Empty X, empty I and the zero coefficient ring remain allowed.
